title: Robustness of Chatbot LLM Judgments of Presidential Actions and Hypothetical Reforms
abstract: arXiv:2610.39398v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Chatbots are increasingly consulted about public affairs, and their judgments of policies are useful only if they are robust. We measure this robustness in the setting of an ordinary user, through consumer chat interfaces. For 30 days, five chatbot configurations (Mistral, Gemini Flash, Claude Sonnet, and Claude Opus at two effort settings) were asked twice a day to score the long-term effect on the United States of 40 actions of the last four presidential administrations and of 15 hypothetical reforms, each with a confidence and a short comment. The judgments are robust: all configurations agree on the sign and the ranking of the administrations' mean scores, and two different configurations asked on the same day give opposite signs to the same action in about 4% of cases. translated_title: 聊天机器人LLM对总统行动与假设性改革判断的稳健性
translated_abstract: 聊天机器人越来越多地被用户咨询公共事务，而它们对政策的判断只有在稳健可靠的情况下才有用。本研究在普通用户的使用场景下，通过消费级聊天界面测量了这种稳健性。在30天内，研究团队每天两次询问五种聊天机器人配置，要求其对最近四届总统政府的40项行动以及15项假设性改革对美国的长期影响进行评分，每次评分均附带置信度评价和简短评论。结果表明这些判断是稳健的：所有配置对各届政府平均得分的符号（正负性）和排名意见一致；同一天询问的两个不同配置对同一行动给出相反符号的情况仅约占4%。不同日期的回答比同日回答（后者共享题目的提问顺序）差异更大，且这种差异在一个月内缓慢增长，除了……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过30天内每天两次询问五种聊天机器人配置对总统行动和假设性改革进行评分，发现LLM的判断总体稳健——各配置对评分符号与排名高度一致，同日不同配置给出相反评分的情况仅约4%。
en_tdlr: By querying five chatbot configurations twice daily over 30 days to score presidential actions and hypothetical reforms, this study finds that LLM judgments are robust—configurations agree on the signs and rankings of scores, with opposite-sign disagreements between same-day configurations occurring in only about 4% of cases.
